content_zh:
永平八年，冬。
文安县，羊粪胡同深处。
一间瓦房里，路沉裹着硬冷的旧棉被躺炕上，屋里晦暗，火炉里那点可怜的火光和热气，驱不散老屋里的阴冷。
他脸膛上泛着抹青灰死气，有气无力地骂道
“贼老天”
他恨这世道，更恨那个走了狗屎运的李天瑞。
十年前，他还只是个刚毕业的大学生，过马路没撞大运，被一辆闯红灯的老头乐给撞飞，再睁眼，已到了这鬼地方。
刚一穿越，爹妈就死于时疫，他成了孤儿。
为了活命，挨饿受冻，捡过馊饭，跟野狗抢过食，命比脚下踩着的泥巴还贱。
好在，他凭着一股不要命的狠劲，和街头摸爬滚打悟出来的几手粗浅拳脚，硬是在这南城，用拳头和血汗，打下了一块地盘。
羊圈街，因挨着几个羊圈而得名。名贱，地也贱。
街面上挤着十来家食肆、酒店和商铺，都是些末等的店铺，不插幌子，不挂字号，来喝酒吃饭的，都是扛活拉车卖苦力的底层人。
路沉带着几个兄弟，在这条街收些平安钱。
名头好听，实则就是保护费。
靠着这笔进项，日子过得还算滋润，有吃有喝的。
李天瑞这厮年纪不大，比路沉小一岁，尽喜欢干些下作勾当，深更半夜去踹寡妇的门，扒墙头偷瞧人家未出阁的闺女洗澡，吃拿摊贩的东西从不给铜子儿。
整条街被他搅得鸡犬不宁。
街坊们不堪其扰，便一起找到路沉诉苦。
他既每月收取街坊的平安钱，总不能坐视这无赖把整条街搅黄。
遂出手教训了李天瑞两回，没下重手，只想让他收敛点。

谁曾想，这腌臜泼才竟走了狗屎运，被一个叫青河门的江湖门派瞧上了眼。
这下可好，李天瑞摇身一变，成了门里弟子。
祸事紧随而至。
李天瑞的师姐找上门，替她那受了欺负的瘪三师弟主持公道。
路沉那几手，在街面上逞凶斗狠还能唬人。
在这种真正练过武的人面前，就是个笑话。
他只记得眼前发黑，骨头嘎吱响，就像条破麻袋一样被扔在臭水沟边，要不是几个手下把他拖回这间破瓦房里，他早就该去阎王爷那儿报到了。
“咳……”
路沉猛咳一声，吐出一口淤血，浑身脱力地瘫回炕上。
“老大，吃饭啦，今天有猪头肉，香着呢！”
一个生得敦实，脸皮黑得赛锅底的青年撞开门钻进来，他一边搓着冻僵的手，一边从怀里掏出一个油纸包。
content_en:
In the eighth year of Yongping, winter.
Wen'an County, deep in the Yangdung Alley.
In a tile-roofed house, Lu Shen was wrapped in a cold old quilt and lying on the kang. The room was dark, and the pitiful firelight and heat in the stove could not dispel the coldness in the old house.
His face was filled with a smeared look of death, and he cursed feebly.
"God damn it"
He hated this world, and even more so, he hated Li Tianrui who was so lucky.
Ten years ago, he was just a newly graduated college student. When he crossed the road without any luck, he was hit by an old car that ran a red light. When he opened his eyes again, he was already in this hellish place.
As soon as he traveled through time, his parents died of an epidemic and he became an orphan.
In order to survive, I went hungry and cold, picked up rotten rice, and snatched food from wild dogs. My life was worth less than the mud under my feet.
Fortunately, with his life-threatening ferocity and a few rough fists and kicks that he had learned through the streets, he just managed to establish a territory in Nancheng with his fists and blood and sweat.
Sheepfold Street is named after several sheepfolds. The reputation is cheap, and the land is also cheap.
There are about a dozen restaurants, hotels and shops crowded on the street. They are all low-class shops. They have no pretense or brand name. Those who come to drink and eat are all low-level people who work hard and work as carts.
Lu Chen took a few brothers to collect some peace money on this street.
The name sounds nice, but in reality it’s just protection money.
With this income, I can live a relatively comfortable life, with plenty to eat and drink.
Li Tianrui is young, one year younger than Lu Chen. He likes to do some dirty tricks. He would kick in the widow's door in the middle of the night, peek over the wall to watch the daughter who has not left the house to take a bath, and never give any money to the vendors for food.
The whole street was disturbed by him.
The neighbors couldn't bear the disturbance, so they went to the road to complain together.
Since he collects peace money from the neighbors every month, he can't just sit back and watch this scoundrel ruin the whole street.
So he taught Li Tianrui a lesson twice. He didn't do anything harsh, but just wanted him to restrain himself.
Who would have thought that this shameless talent would have the bad luck to be spotted by a martial arts sect called Qinghemen.
This is great, Li Tianrui suddenly transformed and became a disciple of the sect.
Disaster soon followed.
Li Tianrui's senior sister came to seek justice for her third junior brother who had been bullied.
Lu Chen's skills could be used to show off his ferocity on the street and also to bluff people.
In front of people like this who have actually practiced martial arts, it's just a joke.
He only remembered the blackness in front of his eyes, the crunching of his bones, and being thrown by the smelly ditch like a broken sack. If a few men hadn't dragged him back to this shabby tile house, he should have reported to the Lord of Hell long ago.
"Ahem..."
Lu Chen coughed violently, spit out a mouthful of blood, and collapsed back on the kang, exhausted.
"Boss, it's time to eat. Today we have pork head meat. It's delicious!"
A young man with a stocky build and a face as dark as a pot broke open the door and got in. While rubbing his frozen hands, he took out a greased paper bag from his arms.
